recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下，大量深染的小淋巴球背景中，散布許多具淡染細胞質、大核與明顯核仁的大型非典型細胞，部分帶有周圍空暈（lacunar 樣），符合 SLL 背景下的 Hodgkin 型大細胞。
features: Background of numerous small, round, hyperchromatic mature-appearing lymphocytes
Scattered large atypical cells with abundant pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Large vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli in the large cells
Some large cells show retraction artifact producing lacunar-like halos
Polymorphous areas with histiocytes/epithelioid cells admixed with the large cells
Diffuse effacement of architecture; small vessels with red cells
describe_en: Sections of lymph node show diffuse effacement by a background of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes. Within this background there are numerous scattered large atypical cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, some with lacunar-like retraction halos, accompanied by histiocytes. Immunophenotyping (CD30, CD15, PAX5, CD45, CD20) is needed to confirm Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell identity. Findings are consistent with small lymphocytic lymphoma with Hodgkin-type Richter transformation.

ddx.vs: Paraimmunoblasts are medium-sized with a single central nucleolus and are CD20+/CD30-, unlike HRS cells which are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD45 negativity.
DLBCL forms confluent sheets of large CD20+ B cells rather than scattered large cells within a small lymphocyte background.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: Background atypical T cells with aberrant T-cell phenotype or clonal TCR rearrangement distinguish it; here the background is CD20+ SLL.
